svg.text: Segregation of Duties (SoD) Policy Matrix — Entra ID Governance
HARD SoD — Blocked by Conditional Access policy; cannot be held simultaneously
SOFT SoD — Requires manager + ISSO justification; PIM time-limited override only
COMPATIBLE — No conflict; may be held simultaneously without restriction
Detection: Entra Identity Governance — SoD Violation Report
Violations surface in the Entra admin portal under Identity Governance > Entitlement Management > Access Packages > SoD policies.
Hard violations are blocked at assignment; soft violations generate a risk event in Identity Protection requiring ISSO acknowledgement within 48 hours.
